parole.significato: an admiral (a naval officer of the highest rank; the commander of a country's naval forces)
parole.testo: From Old French admiral, from Medieval Latin admiralis, from Arabic أَمِير (ʔamīr, “commander”) + -alis (“-al”) under influence from admīrārī (“to admire, to respect”).
From Old French cancelier, chancelier (“chancellor”) from Medieval Latin cancellārius, from Latin cancellī.
